title: C2 Detection and Evasion
description: Beacons with and without jitter, DNS exfiltration and alert correlation: play attacker and defender against the same traffic.

1.title: Beaconing: the metronome that betrays you

detection-evasion-t01-q01.prompt: Send 3+ beacons WITHOUT jitter (interval=5) and run /detect. What alert TYPE does the engine fire?

detection-evasion-t01-q02.prompt: Submit the flag the detector gives you for catching your 3 metronomic beacons.

detection-evasion-t01-q03.prompt: Now send 3+ beacons WITH jitter=40 and check /detect again. What SEVERITY does the entry they generate have (LOW/HIGH/CRITICAL)?

detection-evasion-t02-q01.prompt: Why is DNS such a popular exfiltration channel? Because firewalls almost always allow outbound DNS towards ___ (what?)

detection-evasion-t02-q02.prompt: Exfiltrate data encoded in a long subdomain (over 30 characters) via /dns. Submit the flag.

detection-evasion-t02-q03.prompt: As the defender, generate enough suspicious traffic for /detect to cross 2+ alerts and flag correlated_attack. Submit the final flag.
